children: Office Properties Income Trust priced $425 million of 8.75% senior secured notes due 2031 and plans to use proceeds to repay secured credit facilities.
Priced $425 million aggregate principal of 8.75% senior secured notes due 2031 in a Rule 144A/Reg S private offering.
Notes will be guaranteed by certain subsidiaries and secured by first-priority liens on 19 office properties and equity pledges.
Settlement expected September 24, 2026, subject to customary closing conditions.
Company expects net proceeds plus cash on hand to repay outstanding borrowings under its secured revolving credit facility and secured term loan.
